dct_description_sm:
This layer displays the boundaries of neighbourhoods which make up the City of Kingston. For each neighbourhood, the Community Census Profile is linked to provide additional information and statistics for each area.

For more information about communities in Kingston, including additional maps and census data, please visit the City's website.
